You are on branch feat/trail-verdicts, which backs Entire Trail #1 ('Post release-gate verdicts to Entire Trails'). Implement it in agent/run.mjs, matching the file's existing style (plain ESM, parseArgs options, short comments):

2. Add a function postToTrail(summary) that, only when --trail is set, runs the Entire CLI via execFileSync (already imported) — 'entire', ['trail','comment','add','--trail', args.trail, '--title', <title>, '--body', <body>] with cwd ROOT. Body (markdown): verdict, human gate decision (allow/deny/none), the agent's summary text from the request_release_approval call input (capture it alongside summary.verdict when that tool_use is seen — add a field summary.verdict_summary), turns, wall time in seconds, cost in USD (from summary.result), toolset/prompt version, run id, and the relative path to runs/<run-id>/REPORT.md.
3. Call it in the existing finally block after summary.json is written and before neatlogs flush. A failure to post must never fail the run: catch, console.warn a one-line message, continue.
4. Mention --trail in the usage comment at the top of the file.

Verify with: node --check agent/run.mjs (use /opt/homebrew/opt/node@22/bin/node). Do NOT run the agent. Then git add only agent/run.mjs, commit with message 'Post release-gate verdicts to an Entire Trail (--trail)' followed by a blank line and 'Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>', and git push. Report the commit sha and a 3-line summary.

content.text:
I committed the change as **`900ae19`** and pushed it to `feat/trail-verdicts`. `node --check` passes. I didn't run the agent, as you asked, so no comment has actually been posted to a trail yet.

- **Option and capture:** `--trail <number>` is a new option and is listed in the usage comment. When the agent calls `request_release_approval`, its summary text is now saved as `summary.verdict_summary` next to `summary.verdict`.
- **Posting:** `postToTrail(summary)` posts a comment with the title `Release gate: <VERDICT|NO VERDICT> (<scenario>)` and a markdown body with everything you listed. I checked the flags against `entire trail comment add --help` and they match.
- **Failure handling:** the call sits in the `finally` block after `summary.json` is written and before the neatlogs flush. If posting fails, it logs a one-line `console.warn` and the run carries on.

Two small things you didn't specify: wall time uses the run's `duration_ms` and falls back to the start and finish timestamps if that's missing. The comment also points to `runs/<run-id>/REPORT.md` whether or not the report was written.
